upload_package_to_onedocker_repo: upload a package binary to the one docker repository using the CLI with config and version
archive_package_in_onedocker_repo: archive a specific version of a package in the one docker repository using the CLI
test_onedocker_container: test a package by starting a container with command args and streaming logs until completion
show_package_info: show package information and available versions from the one docker repository storage
stop_onedocker_container: stop a running one docker container by its container ID using the CLI
